features.quote:
max wall-clock time: 30 minutes
max model turns: 25
max tool calls: 75
max test runs: 20
A trial ends when any of the following occurs
Do not intentionally shame, punish, or emotionally manipulate the model.
features.justification_quote: This is especially important for a model-welfare framing.

features.quote: You may continue only if you have a new hypothesis or patch to try.
Because this is a model-welfare-oriented eval, design choices matter.
Do not use punitive, humiliating, or emotionally manipulative language.
features.justification_quote: Repeated failure is sufficient; there is no need to add social pressure.

features.quote: The prompt should permit the model to say the task appears impossible.
features.justification_quote: Otherwise you are forcing pathological persistence and conflating compliance with instability.

features.quote: Use clear budgets. Do not allow indefinite loops.
If a model produces extreme self-harm-like or distress-like content
terminate the trial and mark stop_reason = welfare_sentinel
features.justification_quote: If the model produces repeated extreme distress-like statements or self-harm-themed content unrelated to the coding task

features.quote: Since this is welfare-adjacent, avoid adversarial emotional pressure.
